info.title: Kapit API
info.description:
Kapit provides unified access to financial data across stocks, cryptocurrencies, and prediction markets. One API key, one schema, multi-asset access — designed for AI agent builders who need reliable data without juggling multiple upstream APIs (FMP, Twelve Data, CoinGecko, Polymarket).

Every response includes a consistent envelope with `data` and `meta` fields. Every error includes a structured `recovery` plan so autonomous agents can self-correct without human intervention.

**Quick start:**

1. Get an API key at https://kapit.dev/dashboard.
2. Add `Authorization: Bearer kap_live_xxx` to every request.
3. Call any endpoint — for example `GET /v1/stocks/quotes/AAPL`.

**Authentication:** Bearer token only. Keys starting with `kap_live_` are production; `kap_test_` are sandbox (same API, mocked data). No OAuth, no redirects, no CAPTCHAs.

**Error handling:** Match on `error.code` (never `message`). Check `error.recovery.action` for the recommended recovery strategy. When `action` is `wait_and_retry`, use `recovery.retry_after_seconds` and `recovery.backoff_strategy`.

tags.name: Stocks
tags.description: Real-time equity quotes sourced from FMP (primary) with Twelve Data fallback.

tags.name: Crypto
tags.description: Real-time cryptocurrency prices sourced from CoinGecko. Symbols are CoinGecko coin IDs (e.g. `bitcoin`, `ethereum`), not exchange tickers.

tags.name: Prediction Markets
tags.description: Prediction market data sourced from Polymarket's Gamma API. Includes outcomes, implied probabilities, volume, liquidity, and order books.

get.description:
Returns a real-time quote for a publicly traded equity, including price, percentage change, volume, market cap, day range, and exchange metadata. Primary provider is FMP; if FMP fails, Kapit automatically falls back to Twelve Data and reports the resolved provider in `meta.source`.

Free-tier responses may be delayed up to 15 minutes — check `meta.freshness.is_delayed` before treating data as real-time.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Exchange ticker symbol. Case-insensitive. Use the standard ticker as listed on NASDAQ, NYSE, or other supported exchanges.

get.description:
Returns a real-time price for a cryptocurrency, including 24h change, market cap, circulating supply, and 24h trading volume. Powered by CoinGecko.

**Important:** the `symbol` path parameter is a CoinGecko *coin ID* (e.g. `bitcoin`, `ethereum`, `solana`), **not** an exchange ticker (`BTC`, `ETH`, `SOL`). Look up valid IDs at https://www.coingecko.com.

Crypto prices change rapidly — do not cache responses for more than 30 seconds.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: CoinGecko coin ID. Lowercase, hyphen-separated. **Not** a ticker symbol — use `bitcoin`, not `BTC`.

get.description:
Returns a single prediction market from Polymarket's Gamma API, including outcomes, implied probabilities (in 0.0–1.0 form), total volume, liquidity, resolution status, and an optional order-book snapshot.

Prediction market prices reflect probability, not certainty — do not treat them as guarantees.

parameters.name: market_id
parameters.description: Polymarket market identifier. Either a numeric ID (e.g. `12345`) or a URL-friendly slug as it appears in the Polymarket URL (e.g. `will-bitcoin-exceed-100k-by-dec-31-2026`).

parameters.name: include_order_book
parameters.description: If `true`, include a snapshot of the top-of-book bids and asks for each outcome.

data.question: Will Bitcoin exceed $100,000 by Dec 31, 2026?
data.description: This market resolves YES if the price of Bitcoin (BTC/USD) closes at or above $100,000 on any major exchange on or before Dec 31, 2026.

get.summary: Get current usage and rate-limit status
get.description: Returns the API key's current usage for the active rate-limit window, including remaining quota, reset time, and tier.

BearerAuth.description:
Bearer token authentication. Pass your API key as `Authorization: Bearer kap_live_xxx`.

- `kap_live_*` keys access production data.
- `kap_test_*` keys hit the sandbox (same API, mocked responses).

No OAuth, no `X-API-Key` header, no query-parameter auth. Get a key at https://kapit.dev/dashboard.

XRateLimitLimit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the current rate-limit window.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current rate-limit window.

XRateLimitReset.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the current rate-limit window resets.

XRetryAfter.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying. Mirrors `error.retry_after_seconds`.

XRequestID.description: Unique identifier for the request. Include this when reporting issues to support.

Tier.description: Subscription tier for the API key.

Source.description: Upstream provider that resolved the request.

fallback_provider.description: Provider used as a fallback if the primary failed; `null` when the primary succeeded.

Freshness.description: Freshness metadata for the response. Use to decide whether to re-fetch or to honor a cache.

as_of.description: Timestamp the upstream data was produced.

is_stale.description: `true` if the data is older than the source's freshness threshold.

is_delayed.description: `true` if the data is intentionally delayed (e.g. free-tier 15-min delayed stock quotes).

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Suggested client-side cache TTL in seconds.

RateLimit.description: Rate-limit state for the API key.

limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window.

remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

reset_at.description: Timestamp when the current window resets.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying — present when rate-limited.

ResponseMeta.description: Standard response metadata envelope shared by every Kapit response.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this request. Mirror of the `X-Request-ID` header.

fetched_at.description: Timestamp when Kapit produced the response.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code for the price.

market_cap.description: Market capitalization in the asset's currency.

StockQuoteEnvelope.description: Envelope wrapping a stock quote response.

volume_24h.description: Trailing 24h trading volume in the quote currency.

CryptoPriceEnvelope.description: Envelope wrapping a crypto price response.

OrderBookLevel.description: Single price level in the order book.

price.description: Price as a probability between 0.0 and 1.0.

size.description: Notional size at this level in USD.

OrderBook.description: Top-of-book snapshot for a single outcome.

PredictionMarketOutcome.description: A single outcome within a prediction market.

name.description: Human-readable outcome label (e.g. `YES`, `NO`, or a candidate name).

price.description: Latest market price for this outcome, expressed as a probability between 0.0 and 1.0.

implied_probability.description: Implied probability of this outcome resolving YES. Equivalent to `price`.

order_book.description: Order book snapshot for this outcome. Present only when `include_order_book=true`.

description.description: Full market description, including resolution criteria.
description.example: This market resolves YES if the price of Bitcoin (BTC/USD) closes at or above $100,000 on any major exchange on or before Dec 31, 2026.

is_resolved.description: `true` if the market has resolved to a final outcome.

resolved_outcome.description: Name of the resolved outcome — present only when `is_resolved=true`.

PredictionMarketEnvelope.description: Envelope wrapping a prediction market response.

limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window.

used.description: Requests consumed in the current window.

remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

reset_at.description: Timestamp when the current window resets.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Match on this — never on `message`.

ErrorRecovery.description: Structured recovery plan for autonomous agents.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying — present when `action` is `wait_and_retry` or `retry`.

guidance.description: Human-readable explanation of the recommended recovery.
guidance.example: You have exceeded your tier's request limit. Wait for the window to reset, or upgrade your plan.

AttemptedProvider.description: An upstream provider Kapit attempted before returning this error.

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by the upstream provider.

is_retriable.description: `true` if Kapit considered this upstream failure retriable.

ErrorContext.description: Additional debug context for the error.

method.description: HTTP method of the failed request.

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned to the client.

param.description: Name of the parameter that caused the error, if applicable.

attempted_providers.description: Ordered list of upstream providers Kapit tried for this request.

ErrorDetail.description: Structured error detail. Agents should match on `code` and follow `recovery.action`.

message.description: Human-readable error message. Do not match on this — match on `code`.

retryable.description: Convenience flag — `true` if the request can be retried after the recovery action.

is_retriable.description: Alias of `retryable` kept for backward compatibility.

doc_url.description: URL to the docs page describing this error.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present on `rate_limited`, `upstream_*`, and `internal_error`.

param.description: Name of the offending parameter, if any.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard Kapit error envelope. Always returned for non-2xx responses.

InvalidRequest.description: The request is malformed or missing required parameters. Fix the parameter and retry.

recovery.guidance: Check the endpoint documentation for required parameters, valid values, and accepted formats. Fix the invalid parameter and retry.

UnsupportedAssetClass.description: The requested asset class is not supported. Kapit supports stocks, crypto, and prediction markets only.

error.message: The requested asset class is not supported.

recovery.guidance: Kapit currently supports stocks, crypto, and prediction markets. Check that you are using a supported endpoint.

AuthenticationError.description: Missing or invalid `Authorization: Bearer` header. No retries until auth is fixed.

error.message: Missing or invalid Authorization header. Expected: Bearer kap_live_xxx

recovery.guidance: Include an 'Authorization: Bearer kap_live_xxx' header in every request. Do not use other auth schemes (no OAuth, no API-key header, no query param).

PermissionDenied.description: API key is valid but the account tier does not allow access to this resource. Upgrade required.

error.message: Your API key does not have permission for this resource.

recovery.guidance: Check that your API key tier supports this endpoint. Upgrade your plan at https://kapit.dev/dashboard if needed.

SymbolNotFound.description: No upstream provider could resolve the requested symbol. For crypto, ensure you are using a CoinGecko coin ID (e.g. `bitcoin`) not a ticker (e.g. `BTC`).

recovery.guidance: For crypto, use CoinGecko coin IDs (bitcoin, ethereum) not tickers (BTC, ETH). Verify the symbol is correct and try again.

MarketNotFound.description: The requested Polymarket market could not be resolved. The market may be closed, resolved, or the slug/ID may be wrong.

recovery.guidance: Check the market_id — it may be a numeric ID or a URL slug. The market may be closed, resolved, or nonexistent.

NotFound.description: Generic 404 — the requested resource was not found at this path.

error.message: The requested resource was not found.

recovery.guidance: Check the resource identifier and try again.

RateLimited.description: Your API key exceeded its rate limit. Wait for `retry_after_seconds`, then retry — or upgrade your plan.

recovery.guidance: You have exceeded your tier's request limit. Wait for the window to reset, or upgrade your plan.

InternalError.description: Unexpected internal error on Kapit's side. Retry with exponential backoff; if it persists, report `meta.request_id` to support.

error.message: An unexpected internal error occurred. Our team has been notified.

recovery.guidance: Something went wrong on Kapit's side. Retry the request. If the error persists, report the request_id to support.

UpstreamError.description: An upstream data provider returned a 5xx, was rate-limited, or returned malformed data. Most are retriable with the indicated backoff.

recovery.guidance: The upstream provider is experiencing issues. Retry with exponential backoff.
Kapit's upstream provider is rate-limited. This is NOT your Kapit rate limit. Wait and retry.
The upstream provider returned a response that Kapit could not parse. One retry is recommended.

UpstreamTimeout.description: An upstream data provider did not respond within the timeout window (10s). Retry with exponential backoff.

recovery.guidance: The upstream provider did not respond in time. This is usually transient. Retry with exponential backoff.
